{{Quote|And you'll have to sign a waiver, because Tropix Resorts cannot be held responsible for any death, injury, damage, or other untoward incident caused by, or relating to, hunting, fishing or exploration in any area more than ten meters offshore, or beyond a depth of fifty meters-|Tropix Resorts Employee|<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
'''Tropix Resorts''' ran the resort on [[Tropix island]] on [[Dorumaa]]. It is unknown if it was a subsidiary of [[Dorumaa Resort]], or if the [[Dorumaa Investment Group]] started to let other companies develop some of the moon's islands.
